title: Goldie's Tiered Mobs
description: adds Tiered mobs that gets stronger the farther away from 0 0 + custom items to help defend yourself
body:
# Info About my datapack

- this datapack adds 7 tiers of mobs to minecraft. Each tier makes the mobs stronger.
to combat the mobs stregth, players can now craft weapons and gears that are stronger than vanilla minecraft items.

- The tiers of mobs goes higher the farther they are from 0 0 0 (x,y,z)
there will be a sidebar that showes what difficulty the zone your at is.
the highest zone possible is zone 12 being 10k blocks from 0 0 0(good luck surviving there)

- there are also 4 new structures for the player to raid and get exclusive items.
3 lay around the surface. when beaten, gives the player Dragon chestplates. Dragon chestplate has its own tiers getting stronger by each tier.
the other structure is a tower. the higher the floor, the stronger and harder the mobs.



# Installing Problems, but still posible to use

Found out that the installing is broken or something... dont know how to fix it. the zip file just doesnt work.
But if you still want to use the datapack. Just extract the file and manualy and place it in your worlds datapack folder. That still works, just not convenient :(

Im working on fixing it
